comment: The plugin is on the census skip list: instantiating either model crashes the scan, so there are no scanned positions and every position used here was read out of the ModuleWidget constructor in src/Module.cpp. The installed build is 2.1.15 and the shipped commit is c372f06. The crash is visible in the code: EmbeddedLFMModuleWidget builds an EmbeddedProjectMWidget in its constructor, which calls glfwCreateWindow and starts a projectM render thread, and then reads w->getRenderer()->window to build the resize handle; LFMModuleWidget calls glfwInit and glfwCreateWindow itself to open a second operating-system window, and stores the ModuleWidget in that window's user pointer through reinterpret_cast<WindowedRenderer*>, which is not that type. Both models share the LFMModule class, so all ten parameters and all eight inputs exist on both. No Frames is on the panel menu only where ARCH_MAC is undefined, and it is absent from the installed build, so it is left out.
